guidePatchInstructions.heading: Start with the state’s actual model and sales facts
paragraphs: The Attorney General says offerings must be registered before franchises are offered or sold in or from New York unless an exemption applies. Current GBL 681(3) has two alternative franchise branches: a substantially prescribed marketing plan plus a required direct or indirect fee, or substantial association with the designated commercial symbol plus that fee. It does not require both plan and symbol elements in every covered arrangement.

Section 681 separately defines fee exclusions, area and subfranchise roles, uninterrupted renewals and territorial connections. Part 200.1 supplies further fee and advice/training meanings. Map the actual seller, rights, payments, support, offer/acceptance and operating facts before applying a branch or exemption. This guide determines no actual classification or exemption.

guidePatchInstructions.heading: A meeting can be earlier than the planned signature
paragraphs: GBL 683(8) requires the offering prospectus and proposed agreements at the earliest of the first personal meeting, at least ten business days before a binding franchise or other agreement, or at least ten days before receipt of consideration. It defines the covered first face-to-face meeting by its purpose of discussing a franchise sale or possible sale.

The currently linked AG addendum, revised April 2, 2024, instead uses ten-business-day phrasing alongside agreement execution or related payment. Preserve that literal source difference and the independent federal 14-calendar-day requirement. Do not silently replace the statute’s ten-day payment wording with ten business days or use the federal signature countdown as the only meeting/payment gate. Record actual documents, meetings, delivery, signatures and money before applying the requirements.

rulePatchInstructions.requirement: GBL 681(3) uses alternative marketing-plan-plus-fee OR commercial-symbol-plus-fee branches. Apply its actual fee exclusions, area/subfranchise and offer/nexus definitions alongside the further Part 200.1 meanings; no actual model or exemption is decided.

Keep GBL 683(8)’s first-personal-meeting, ten-business-day agreement and ten-day consideration branches distinct. The current AG addendum’s payment wording uses ten business days; preserve that source difference alongside the independent federal clock. GBL 687(4)–(5) and the addendum supply their own qualified rights/release and questionnaire rules.
